summary_1line: Satyaki battles Drona, fights while driving his own chariot, scatters Kaurava forces, and slays King Sudarsana while advancing along Arjuna’s path.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki fights Drona while holding the reins himself as his driver lies unconscious on the chariot floor.
Drona’s driverless chariot spins in wild circles across the battlefield as frightened warriors shout to seize the horses.
Satyaki’s razor-headed arrow severs Sudarsana’s crowned head, which falls like a full moon from the sky.
